subject: sociology

moments.title: Theorising Patriarchy
moments.body: Walby distinguishes six structures of patriarchy: household production, paid work, the state, male violence, sexuality and culture.
moments.takeaway: Patriarchy is multi-structural and historically variable.

moments.title: Gender Transformations
moments.body: Walby argues patriarchy has shifted from private to public form, integrating women into paid work while maintaining gender hierarchies.
moments.takeaway: Gender regimes change rather than disappear.

moments.title: Globalization and Inequalities
moments.body: Walby integrates gender, class, ethnicity and global structures into a complex-systems framework.
moments.takeaway: Gender analysis is reframed for a global economy.

now.title: Patriarchy across regimes
now.body: Walby's framework informs comparative research on gender regimes across welfare states and Global South contexts.
now.open_questions: How does the gig economy reshape Walby's six structures?

reflection: Walby kept patriarchy as a serious analytic category when many sociologists abandoned the term.
